Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1 of turbine
oil pump,which must be performed every 
five years as indicated by Y5 in above title block.
Lubrication oil pump is used for lubricate bearing 1-2-3 coupling 
1-2, accessory gears and reduction gears
The first draft initiated and tested by 
eng. Sameh Sobhi Elsayed, reviewed by
 eng. Abed Esmail, revised by 
eng. Abouda Elbana Quality control MDEPC, 
accepted by general manager eng. Yosry Abd El-Maksoud and approved by
eng. Farouk Awad head sector of Talkha
Power Station.
This document accepted by 
eng. Samir Abdel Gilil 
; MDEPC
inspection and quality control general
manager, MPIS coordinator, and certified by inspection and quality head sector
eng. Mohamed Nageeb .
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance
staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Wear your
safety and healthy, shoes and gloves pairs...etc.
Unit out of service.
Isolate the circuit 
breaker of the pump
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance
staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Wear your
safety and healthy, shoes and gloves pairs...etc.
Unit out of service.
Isolate the circuit 
breaker of the pump
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
Tools and Equipments
Complete maintenance
tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Rag
Work to be carried out
Disassembly
Remove coupling halves (68)
Remove strainer (59)
Remove strainer casing cover (5)
Check axial clearance for pump shaft (1/8)
Remove retaining ring (83)
Remove impeller stop nut (15)
Remove impeller washer (16)
Pull impeller (3)
Remove casing (2) from connecting pipe (50)
Remove nuts and bolts fastening pipe (50) from the cover plate (56)
Remove thrust bearing cover (24), ball bearing lock nut (29) and ball bearing 
 lock washer (28)
The 
 ball bearing is now accessible for removal
Inspection and repair:
Inspect all parts of the pump for cracks, damage, wearing and change if it 
 needed to change
Cleaning all parts before reassembly
Make run out of the shaft (.0003)
Reassembly
Clean the shaft (7)
Install ball bearing and thrust (27)
Install ball bearing lock washer (28)
Install ball bearing lock nut (29)
Install thrust bearing cover (24)
Tight all details fastening pipe (50) to the cover plate (56)
Install impeller (3)
Install impeller washer (16)
Install impeller stop nut (15)
Install retaining ring (83)
Measure and adjust axial clearance of pump shaft (1/8)
Install strainer casing cover (5)
Install strainer (59)
Install and tight casing (2) with connecting pipe (5)
Connect pump discharge with piping
Install coupling halves (68)
Measure and adjust alignment between pump and motor
Checking Pump during operation
Check Lube oil pressure and discharge of the pump
Check Vibration for lube oil pump and record it.
